title: Job Fair
one_paragraph_synopsis: In "Job Fair," Michael and the Dunder Mifflin team attend a high school job fair with minimal materials, aiming to recruit interns despite challenges such as limited supplies and competition. Meanwhile, Jim works on improving his standing during probation by meeting a potential client on the golf course, ultimately closing a deal. Dwight enforces office attendance rules in Michael's absence, while Pam explores graphic design opportunities. The episode highlights the characters' efforts and interactions around recruitment, work responsibilities, and personal ambitions, though several outcomes remain uncertain.
